description: The file defines extension composable functions to create scrollbar states for various lazy list or grid components in Jetpack Compose, such as LazyListState, LazyGridState, and LazyStaggeredGridState. It calculates scrollbar thumb size and position based on visible items and scrolling state.

methods.name: scrollbarState
methods.description: Creates a ScrollbarState for a LazyListState that updates based on visible items and scroll position.

methods.description: Creates a ScrollbarState for a LazyGridState that updates based on visible items and scroll position.
